name: log-scatter
description: A labelled scatter chart on a log-scale x axis (cost, size, time) against a linear y axis.

parameters.name: points
parameters.description: list of (label, x, y, colour), x above 0

parameters.name: x_range
parameters.description: (low, high) of the log x axis

parameters.name: x_ticks
parameters.description: list of (value, text) under the x axis

parameters.name: y_ticks
parameters.description: list of (value, text) left of the y axis

returns: VGroup with .axes and .marks (VGroup(dot, label) per point); place(chart, x, y) gives a position
